messages:
zoe_h: Final sanity check for Predict GA tomorrow morning. Need green on SLA wording, docs (quickstart + quota blurb), canary cohorts + rollback triggers, support rota, and billing FAQ. Please ack or flag blockers. @carlos_m @anya_v @frank_r

carlos_m: Infra ok on capacity. Autoscaler tuned, burst handoff documented. Proposed canary: internal -> 1% -> 10% -> full. Rollback conditions: p99 > 400ms OR errors > 0.8% over 10m. Automated fallback to quantized-fallback in staging.

anya_v: Docs: quickstart + error semantics PRs live in staging. Missing: short quota/overage blurb and Dedicated migration note. I'll add quota blurb now. Streaming examples marked "preview" and won't block GA.

frank_r: Support: I'll be primary for GA day + 48h. Need one evening backup (UTC-7). Runbook draft uploaded: detect spike -> automated switch -> post incident -> notify customers. Includes canned email templates.

ops-bot: Preflight check: infra capacity=OK, canary slot reserved 2025-02-12T15:00Z, CI smoke scheduled every 5m against canary endpoint. Synthetic smoke command for docs: ```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{\"input\":\"smoke\"}' | jq '.status'``` assert "ok" + HTTP 200.

zoe_h: SLA draft: p99 <= 300ms (hosted-standard), availability 99.9% monthly. Exceptions: scheduled maint (24h notice) and force majeure. Penalty = service credit prorated up to 1 month. Legal needs to sign trial-credit wording.

legal-bot: Legal note: finalize exact trial-credit line in billing FAQ. Recommended copy: "Trial credits are promotional and non-refundable. Billing disputes to billing@redwood.ai within 30 days." Please confirm placement and I'll sign off.

carlos_m: Monitoring owners: p95/p99 latency, error-rate, token burn SLI, model-quality drift SLI. Alerts: p99 > 400ms OR errors > 0.8% -> page infra. Model-quality drop > 4% -> pause rollout.

anya_v: Quota blurb added: \"If you exceed monthly quota, API returns 429 with X-Quota-Remaining and X-Quota-Reset headers. Contact sales to increase limits.\" Linking FAQ to staging docs now for legal.

frank_r: I can take evenings Tue-Thu week1 for backup. Added to oncall schedule. Runbook link in staging runbooks.

zoe_h: Owners recap: zoe_h (launch lead), carlos_m (infra/runbooks/monitoring), anya_v (docs/billing FAQ), frank_r (support/oncall). Blocker: legal sign-off. If legal clears within 2 hours, we go green and ops-bot will trigger canary per reserved slot.

legal-bot: Reviewed and approved the recommended trial-credit wording. No legal holds.

zoe_h: :shipit: Greenlight. I'll post ship announcement and monitor first cohort with owners on call. Thanks everyone for the quick turn-around.
